basic_details.job_title: College of Engineering Chengannur Heavy Duty College Bus Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: College of Engineering Chengannur, functioning under the Institute of Human Resources Development (IHRD), Government of Kerala, needs a Heavy Duty College Bus Driver on daily wage basis. Candidates with a valid licence and badge, at least 15 years of heavy vehicle driving experience and below 65 years of age may apply. The filled application, with copies of the licence and proof of age, must be submitted at the college by 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About College of Engineering Chengannur
content_sections.text: College of Engineering Chengannur is an engineering college under the Institute of Human Resources Development (IHRD), Government of Kerala, located at Chengannur in Alappuzha district. The bus driver will be engaged for the college's own bus service. The college can be reached on +91 479 2454125 and 8547005032, and by email at [email protected] and [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form is available on the college website ( https://ceconline.edu ) and at the college office. Interested candidates must submit the filled application, together with copies of the licence and proof of age, at the college on or before 10 November 2026. College address as printed on the notice: College of Engineering Chengannur, Chengannur, Alappuzha - 689 121, Kerala, INDIA. The notice does not mention whether the application may be sent by post or must be handed in personally; it only says the application must be submitted at the college by the last date. For details, the notice gives the phone numbers 9048346126 and 9447556722.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for one post, Heavy Duty College Bus Driver, engaged on daily wage basis. The daily wage amount is not specified in the notice. Licence: A valid licence and badge. Experience: Not less than 15 years of experience driving heavy vehicles. Age limit: Below 65 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Nature of engagement: Daily wage basis. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions for the post.
